name: Pick My Costume
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Pick My Costume ranks 169 curated Halloween costumes by how much you can already build. Tell it who's dressing up and what you already own, and it shows which costumes your materials cover best. Search by a specific item to see exactly what you'd still need for each. Every costume has a materials list, step-by-step build guide, and estimated time and effort, with safety notes for most. You can also narrow by vibe, interests, and effort level. No account or signup required.

limitations_ja: 公式説明は169種類と記載。安全上の注記は大半の衣装に付くと説明。
